amount.description: Decimal strings preserve provider precision; amount equals remaining.

label.description: Optional pool label; workspace USD has no inferred total.

amount.description: USD decimal string with the same precision rules as balance amounts.

label.description: Unique within the tool: 1–64 characters from [a-z0-9._ -].

oneOf.description: Primary balance; the first item in balances, not an additional pool.

balances.description: Amp has independent USD and normalized orb-hour pools. Never sum units.

breakdown.description: Cursor cycle spend details in USD; empty for every other tool.

status.description: Always "accepted"; completion arrives through agents.usage SSE.

oneOf.description: Null exactly when nothing was received.

DeviceSampleV1.description:
Request body of `POST /v1/devices/{device_id}/samples`, schema version 1
(docs/devices-ingest.md, "Sample fields"). The handler validates the raw JSON
itself with the contract's error codes; this type documents the shape, and a
test proves the contract examples fit it. Unknown fields are ignored, and the
server-owned fields `health`, `gpus`, `generated_at_ms`, `warnings`,
`maintenance.services` and `maintenance.ups` are rejected.

device_id.description: Must equal the path id and the credential's device.

observed_at_ms.description: Device wall clock (Unix ms) when the fast sample was taken.

sent_at_ms.description: Device wall clock (Unix ms) when this attempt was sent.

session_id.description: Random UUID v4 per agent process start.

oneOf.description: Remote ingest state (docs/devices-ingest.md). Null for factory-gpu.

openapi_sha256.description:
SHA-256 (first 12 hex) of the served `/openapi.json`, byte-identical to
the committed `factory-api/openapi.json` snapshot: the kiosk's API contract.

reason.description: Null on stored, except `clock_unsynchronized`; `duplicate`, `out_of_order` or `expired` on ignored.

clock_skew_ms.description: `sent_at_ms - received_at_ms` of the last accepted request, including latency.

dropped_samples.description: Sequence gaps within a session since factory-api started.

last_received_at_ms.description: Server clock when the last accepted sample arrived; null before the first one.

Layer.description: Declaration order is registry order; diagnosis blames the first failing layer.

ended_ms.description: Null while the episode is open.

peak_loss_percent.description: Peaks over the faulting layer's chosen targets while the episode lasted.

peak_rtt_us.description: Average RTT; null while nothing came back.

NetworkEvent.description:
One degraded or down episode. `state`, `layer` and `reason` are the link
state it records; it is never healthy.

events.description: Newest first: started_ms descending, then id descending.

next_before.description: The last event's id, to pass as `before` for the next page; null on the last page.

oneOf.description: 100% loss for at least DOWN_TICKS consecutive ticks.

jitter_ms.description: Raw buckets: mean of the bursts' mdev. Hourly points: nearest-rank p95.

latency_ms.description: Average is weighted by received replies; all null when nothing came back.

NetworkSpeedTest.description: One stored throughput test. Rates are bits per second; latencies are average RTT to the first wan target.

colo.description: Cloudflare colo code. The public IP is never stored.

download_bps.description: Nearest-rank p90 of per-request rates; null unless the outcome is ok.

download_loaded_latency_ms.description: Bursts run while that direction transferred.

oneOf.description: Null before the first stored test.
The open degraded or down episode; null when healthy.

state.description: The stored open event's state; healthy when none is open.

targets.description: Registry order: lan, wan, dns, tailnet.

RequestRetention.description:
Raw request retention of the API copy (MET-206): rows older than 365 days,
only when the verified rollup, the cost backfill and frozen costs cover them.
Runs after each five-minute rollup run.

cutoff_ms.description: Rows with `ts_ms` strictly below this were eligible in the last run.

detail.description: Skip reasons, error, or a note that pruning continues next run.

oldest_retained_id.description: Lowest request ID still cached after the last run; null when empty.

pruned_at_ms.description: Last run that was allowed to prune, and the rows it deleted.

pruned_rows_since_start.description: Rows deleted by every run since this process started.

skipped_since_ms.description: Start of the current streak of skipped or failed runs; alerts after 24 h.

status.description:
"pending" before the first run; "ok"; "skipped" when a gate is unmet;
"failed" when the job errored, leaving every row in place.

mdev_us.description: Jitter, as iputils computes it: the population standard deviation.

address.description:
What was probed: the gateway or WAN IP, the resolved name, or the
resolved tailnet socket address. Null when it could not be found.

ts_ms.description: Start of the tick; every target in one tick shares it.

SampleMaintenance.description: Only the device-reported parts of maintenance; services and UPS are server-owned.

type.description:
Named SSE event: gpu.sample, ups.sample, ups.event, network.sample, network.speedtest,
llm.request, fleet.change, pricing.changed, agents.usage, or devices.sample. ups.sample
data is UpsCurrent or null on failure. devices.sample data is a device view, or null when
the collector fails. History is not in the event.
ups.event data is UpsEvent, sent once when an event opens and once when it closes.
Zero-length self_test events send both an open frame and a closed frame.
network.sample data is the array of Sample probed by one 30-second tick.
network.speedtest data is the NetworkSpeedTest row, sent once after it is stored.

next_before_ms.description: Pass both cursor fields to avoid skipping simultaneous transitions.

percentiles_approximate.description:
True when percentiles come from merged fixed-bucket latency histograms
(ranges beyond 30 days); otherwise they are exact nearest-rank values.

device_bearer.description: Per-device token (fdv1_ plus 43 base64url characters); the server stores only its SHA-256.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until next refresh, rounded up

get.summary: Active alerts and the last 20 cleared ones, as posted to Slack `#factory-alerts`.

An enrolled remote device: stale after 45 s of transport or collection age, and
`unknown` until its first fresh sample since factory-api started. `factory-gpu`
is served the same way at its literal path.

post.summary:
One remote sample (docs/devices-ingest.md). Checks run in the contract's order:
method, Sec-Fetch-Site, credential, device binding, content type, body size,
JSON and schema, then rate. Errors use ApiError, adding `error.field` and, for
`unsupported_schema_version`, `accepted_schema_versions`.

parameters.description: 24h (default), 7d, 30d, 365d. Percentiles are exact nearest-rank values through 30d; 365d percentiles come from merged latency histograms and set percentiles_approximate.
parameters.name: range

get.summary:
Every registry target in layer order with its latest stored sample (null
before the first tick), plus network and clock warnings.

parameters.description: Exclusive cursor: an event id, such as the previous page's next_before. The page continues after that event in (started_ms, id) descending order; an unknown id is a 400.
parameters.name: before

get.summary: Degraded and down episodes, newest first by started_ms then id, the open one included.

1h and 24h read raw bursts in at most 720 buckets per target; jitter is the
mean of the bursts' mdev. 7d and 30d read hourly rollups; jitter is the
nearest-rank p95 of each hour's mdev values. Loss is lost replies over sent.
Throughput tests that started within the range, for charts.

Costs round half-up once per range. Coverage counts intervals between reads
no more than 30s apart. An expired leading partial hour is omitted, not estimated.
GPU energy uses the same covered UPS intervals and right-endpoint rounding.
It is null if GPU coverage is missing or its energy exceeds the UPS load.

parameters.description: Use with next_before_ms to page simultaneous events without loss
parameters.name: before_id

get.summary:
Raw ranges use at most 720 time buckets. All metrics expose min/avg/max;
runtime is the minimum. Longer ranges include the overlapping hourly bucket.
